items.title: Gingerbread Stocking Cookie
items.alt: Stocking-shaped gingerbread cookie with a cream icing cuff, red lattice piping and green peppermint candies.
items.description: A small wrapped-candy decoration sits below the cuff, with white icing pearls defining the toe and heel.

items.title: Gingerbread Rocking Horse Cookie
items.alt: Rocking-horse gingerbread cookie with a turquoise icing saddle, white mane and tail, and a curved decorated rocker.
items.description: The raised front leg and flowing piped mane give the horse a lively profile above the full rocker.

items.title: Gingerbread Cottage with a Round Tower
items.alt: Gingerbread cottage with a tall round tower, pink scalloped candy roofs, green arched door and glowing amber sugar windows.
items.description: White icing curls and red candy dots decorate the walls above a line of colored gumdrops.

items.title: Gingerbread Chalet with Almond Roof
items.alt: Steep-roofed gingerbread chalet with almond-like roof tiles, amber windows and a teal door bearing a tiny wreath.
items.description: Two striped candy posts flank the front beneath thick white roof icing and a star above the doorway.

items.title: Gingerbread Windmill with Wafer Sails
items.alt: Gingerbread windmill with four lattice-patterned wafer sails, a peppermint center and green arched door.
items.description: White icing curls wrap the tapered tower beneath red and green candy accents on the sails.

items.title: Gingerbread Lighthouse with Candy Stripes
items.alt: Tall gingerbread lighthouse with red icing bands, amber lantern windows and a striped peppermint dome.
items.description: Chocolate railing surrounds the lantern room above the tapered tower and round iced cookie base.
